correctness.rationale: State transfer on 48 primitive pairs mod8 has descendants (a,a+b) and (a+b,b). All eight exact integer row annihilator identities and initial numerator coefficients were independently reconstructed; the special residue-4 shorter denominator follows from longer annihilator plus initial values. Coprimality ensures uncancelled modulus-sqrt2 spectral roots, proving separate sharp O(2^(r/2)) fluctuation; stationary uniform pair distribution yields densities 1/12 even and 1/6 odd. Independent 48-state row certificates and 21 dyadic levels checked; finite recurrence certificate supports all depths, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: Bounded finite experiments do not prove unrestricted quantification; proof reconstruction includes stated critical lemmas.

originality.rationale: Qualified PASS: Reznick 2008 gives the primitive-pair dynamics, general equidistribution, and small-modulus computations (two and three). Earlier one-dimensional divisibility difference for mod8 vs mod6 does not provide eight distinct exact reduced generating functions nor each class sharp rate. Resultary search found no direct stronger table, but incomplete coverage is a priority risk.
residual_risks: An older specialized mod8 transfer computation, unpublished Reznick continuation, or OEIS entry could contain equivalent formulas.
Sqrt2 sharpness requires coprime factorization; independently checked algebraically with exact row identities.
